sourcePolicy: Nur Rebrickable Catalog Downloads/CSV, keine MOC-Dateien.
methodology: A collision-free connector transform does not prove that an accessory is presented in a visually plausible direction. Three-view human reviews may approve one deterministic grip and orientation candidate. Every review pins the source geometry and candidate counts so a changed generator or LDraw file fails closed instead of silently reusing stale visual judgment.

reviews.note: Three-view browser inspection on 2026-10-12 confirmed that candidate 6 seats the grip in the hand, keeps the blade outside the body in front view, and hides the blade behind the body silhouette in back view. The automatic candidate 0 instead pointed the blade behind the figure.
